source.note: Indexes selected data from Atlas F, parameter section 0, sections 27-28, 35-36, and Appendix C; source E/K/C/O/X labels are not independent peer review.

editorial_rules.dependencies: Only hard derivational dependencies; analogy and conditional correspondences are represented in maps and must not create downstream dependency edges.
editorial_rules.review_state: proof-in-reference means a local proof-bearing source exists; source-indexed means only extracted/located in v2, not independently recertified.
editorial_rules.ids: SF-O, SF-P and SF-M IDs are persistent; reuse them when revising values and create successors for incompatible definitions.
editorial_rules.parameter_scope: Symbols are typed by stable parameter IDs; the same printed symbol in another scope is not the same variable. Derived quantities and integration constants must not be conflated.
editorial_rules.transformations: Every SF-M contract has coordinate, dependent-variable, parameter, inverse, derivative/time, invariants and information-loss records in contracts.json. An unfilled field is marked not_audited, not guessed.

parameters.name: gram_log_shift
parameters.meaning: u->u+delta_u, A->A exp(r delta_u), B->B exp(-r delta_u) with C unchanged

parameters.name: gudermannian_angle

objects.title: Intrinsic homogeneous Master level hierarchy
objects.note: separate from the norm-angle deformation and spectral shape index

objects.title: Generic cubic Master quartic energy curve
objects.note: smooth genus one only e != 0 and e != -1/4

objects.title: Marked degree-two quotient of Master quartic
objects.note: elliptic isogeny not an isomorphism of marked dynamical flows

objects.title: Chosen first/second fundamental forms of local minimal surface
objects.note: local Gauss-Codazzi; global periods and immersion closing are extra

objects.title: Lamé spectral curve from linearizing periodic Master
objects.formula: periodic ell=3 linearization gives n=2 Lame spectral genus two
objects.note: distinct from nonlinear energy genus-one and intrinsic ell=9 genus-two curves

objects.title: Gram upper-half-plane shape coordinate
objects.note: chi=0 alone does not imply tau_G=i; balanced unit legs needed

objects.title: Mellin transform of the original kernel
Riemann minimal surface circle-radius reduction
objects.note: similar local Duffing form; height h and marked periods are independent data

objects.title: Gudermannian coordinate chart for the canonical kernel
objects.formula: eta=atan(sinh(r*log(x/c))); x=c*exp(asinh(tan eta)/r), S=cos eta,W=sin eta
objects.note: eta is a coordinate whose parameter derivatives depend on whether x or eta is fixed; not an independent fifth variable.

objects.title: Squared canonical field B_sq = S^2, distinct from Gram B
objects.note: The screenshot used B=S^2 locally, and Complete Reference v2 sometimes uses B_0; SF-P-009 is the constant Gram/backbone coefficient B and MUST NOT be identified with B_sq.

objects.title: Single projective conic with circle and hyperbola affine charts
objects.note: one conic and two affine normalizations; projective correspondence is not an isometry

objects.title: Quadratic image parabola in (P,B_sq), invariant-leaf equation
objects.formula: P=(1+W)/2, B_sq=S^2=4P(1-P); P_u=r*B_sq/2, B_sq_u=2*r*B_sq*(1-2P); K=B_sq-4P(1-P) conserved for the free pair
objects.note: the full polynomial ODE has shifted-parabola invariant leaves; canonical orbit is K=0; B_sq must not be named unqualified B

objects.title: Distinct kernel-uniform-angle and squared-profile-beta probability pushforwards
objects.formula: (2r/pi)f(x;r,c)dx=d eta/pi; squared-profile measure dP_q=(r/B(1/2,q))S^(2q)du pushes P to Beta(q,q)
objects.note: Original-kernel P is Beta(1/2,1/2), but squared-profile q=1 P is uniform; these are different measures
